title: Have _eval_one_decision return Annotation instances instead of raw dicts
description:
After the leaf-type dataclass migration, `_eval_one_decision` in `scripts/analysis/blunder_analysis.py` still returns `list[dict]` for annotations. This forces every downstream consumer to handle both `Annotation` dataclass instances (from `load_game_export`) and raw dicts (from the annotator), resulting in ugly `isinstance(annotation, Annotation)` branching in 6 call sites across 4 files:

- `blunder_eval_common.py`: `annotation_decision_index`, `reverse_map_annotations`
- `blunder_audit.py`: `format_play_context`, `_get_current_annotation` callers (x2)
- `blunder_audit_web.py`: `_handle_verdict`
- `leaderboard.py`: `generate_leaderboard`, `generate_format_leaderboard`

Fix: construct `Annotation` instances at the end of `_eval_one_decision` (around line 1274 where `ann["type"] = "blunder"` etc. are injected). Then change `_get_current_annotation` return type from `Annotation | dict | None` to `Annotation | None`, `_auto_ingest_ground_truth` annotations param from `Sequence[Annotation | Mapping]` to `Sequence[Annotation]`, and remove all `isinstance` branches.
